mapper.sql: id, hr_id, job_name, job_desc, requirement, keywords, salary, work_address, work_experience, status, delivery_count, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job ( hr_id, job_name, job_desc, requirement, keywords, salary, work_address, work_experience, status, delivery_count ) VALUES ( #{hrId}, #{jobName}, #{jobDesc}, #{requirement}, #{keywords}, #{salary}, #{workAddress}, #{workExperience}, #{status}, #{deliveryCount} )
mapper.select:
SELECT j.id, j.job_name, j.job_desc, j.salary, j.work_address, j.work_experience, j.keywords, h.company_name, j.status, j.create_time, ( SELECT amr.match_score FROM delivery d LEFT JOIN ai_match_result amr ON amr.delivery_id = d.id WHERE d.job_id = j.id AND d.seeker_id = #{seekerId} ORDER BY d.delivery_time DESC, amr.update_time DESC, amr.id DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS match_score, EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM delivery d WHERE d.job_id = j.id AND d.seeker_id = #{seekerId} ) AS is_delivered FROM job j INNER JOIN hr h ON j.hr_id = h.id WHERE j.status = 1
AND j.job_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{jobName}, '%')
AND j.salary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{salary}, '%')
AND j.work_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{workAddress}, '%')

SELECT j.id, j.job_name, j.job_desc, j.requirement, j.keywords, j.salary, h.company_name, j.work_address, j.work_experience, h.real_name AS hr_name, j.create_time FROM job j INNER JOIN hr h ON j.hr_id = h.id WHERE j.id = #{jobId} AND j.status = 1
